groups.why_chosen: A dashed 'blast radius' box shrinks from all three pipeline stages to just the failed one, paired with two full Gantt schedules whose bar length alone argues the 23% speedup.
groups.what_to_learn: Redraw the same dashed scope box smaller so it wraps only the recovering worker, swap the now-excluded neighbours for their log-table stand-ins, and pair full-width Gantt bars before/after so the blank rows and a bracketed percentage argue the speedup directly.
